name: Ashita no Yukinojou
source:
Before Yukimura Yukinojou could transfer to Kashima school, he immediately got into trouble when he hindered delinquents who were trying to rape a girl. His help, still successful, did not end quite the way the girl wanted, and rumors quickly spreaded about the hero, wrapped in bandages, all around the school.

The girl, Kasuga Serina, who happened to be his new classmate, starts helping Yukinojou to settle into his new life. The school festival is just around the corner, the hectic atmosphere is present everywhere, and Yukinojou is drawn into it against his will.

Not displaying any emotion openly, Yukinojou has his heart sealed that he blames himself for something from his past. It seems like he is running from it, but will he succeed?
translation:
雪村雪之丞尚未正式转入鹿岛学园，便因阻止一群不良少年强奸少女而立即惹上麻烦。尽管他成功救下对方，事情的收场方式却并不符合少女的期望。很快，关于那名浑身缠着绷带的英雄的传闻便传遍校园。

少女春日芹奈恰好成为雪之丞的新同学，并开始帮助他适应新生活。学校祭即将举行，四处都洋溢着忙乱气氛，雪之丞也身不由己地被卷入其中。

雪之丞从不轻易流露情感。他因过去的某件事责怪自己，内心也就此封闭。他似乎一直试图逃离那段往事，但真的能够成功吗？
